transfer_lessons: For joint discrete targets with non-injective physical-rate mapping, direct joint-label prediction can be preferable to predict-rate-then-invert.
Oversampling/SMOTE belongs inside each training fold only; validation/test must retain natural class distribution.
Target encoding must be train-only and preferably cross-fitted/out-of-fold for training rows.
For cascaded/stacked models, stage-2 training features should be out-of-fold predictions from stage 1, not ground-truth intermediates, if deployment receives predicted intermediates.
Report end-to-end cascade metrics in addition to per-stage metrics and propagate intermediate uncertainty.
Adding random noise after prediction is not robustness training; stochastic outputs require a modeled distribution, fixed seeds for reproducibility, and calibrated evaluation.
